V3_cr2o3_tradeoff_evidence_only.jones_2005: UG2 concentrate ~430 g/t at 87% recovery and 2.9% Cr2O3; >1000 g/t at >90% if Cr2O3 relaxed to 4-10% [P]
V3_cr2o3_tradeoff_evidence_only.reading: recovery and concentrate quality trade off; better chromite control moves the operating point, by an amount only a pilot can measure
